2026-11-22.title: Birmingham → Gatlinburg
2026-11-22.note: Load the car Saturday night. Kids ride in pajamas and change at the first stop. Check-in is usually 4pm for cabins, so there is no reason to leave before seven.

slots.why: Breakfast in the car. Snejana should sleep the first leg. I-59 north.
Exit 218, Glenn Blvd. The MAPCO is right off the ramp. Bathrooms, gas, ten minutes of running around. Last stop in Central time.
Clocks jump an hour here. Reset the car clock now so nobody does arrival math wrong later.
Exit 49. Cracker Barrel at the ramp has the fastest kids' lunch on this route and a rocking-chair porch to burn ten minutes on. Stay off the exits closer to Knoxville, they are busier and slower.
Love's at the exit for the last cheap tank. Then US-321 through Maryville to Townsend, about an hour.

slots.what: Into the park at the Townsend Wye
slots.why: Little River Road to Sugarlands, 35 minutes if nobody stops. No cell signal inside the park, so have the cabin directions saved offline before you enter.
Full stock-up before the cabin. One adult shops, one adult walks kids around the lot. If you came in via Wears Valley instead, Kroger at 220 Wears Valley Rd in Pigeon Forge is right on the route.
Mynatt Park on Airport Rd, five minutes from downtown. Creek, picnic tables, clean restrooms. Reviewers note there's no playground; the creek is the playground. Don't sit in the car.

slots.what: Into the cabin. Safety sweep first
slots.why: Before anything is unloaded: hot tub cover strapped and locked, deck doors latched, stair gate up, loft rail checked, fireplace blocked. See the note below. Then unload.
Frozen pizza night. Everybody is wrecked and it is already dark.
Pack-n-play in the darkest room, sound machines on, trash bags over any window facing the porch light. It is 6pm to their bodies, which helps this one night.

2026-11-23.title: Forge a knife, ride the wheel
2026-11-23.note: Everything today sits in two spots: the Old Mill square and The Island, three minutes apart. Iron Mountain opens at 9 and the forge sessions book up, so call (865) 365-4344 today and reserve two: a railroad spike knife for Vlad, a nail knife for Cash.

slots.why: Vlad hammers a railroad spike into a knife, about an hour, $85, ages 13 and up. Cash does the nail knife, ages 5 to 12, $20, with a smith at his elbow the whole time. Closed-toe shoes for both. A sheath is included; engraving is $10 extra and worth it for his.
slots.dest: Iron Mountain Metal Craft, 172 Old Mill Ave, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.what: Allison, Slavik and Snejana: the Old Mill square
slots.why: While the forge runs. The water wheel on the Little Pigeon River, ducks off the dam, the Old Mill General Store with the corn fritter samples, the candy kitchen. All flat, all stroller.
slots.dest: The Old Mill & General Store, 175 Old Mill Ave, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.why: 236 Old Mill Ave. Grass and a riverside path to burn off the forge adrenaline. Free parking here if the mill lot is full.
slots.dest: Patriot Park, 236 Old Mill Ave, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.why: 3341 Old Mill St, across the footbridge. Opens at 11; be at the door, the wait is 30 minutes by noon. Fresh bread, chicken pot pie, kids' mac. The Old Mill Restaurant next door is the bigger, slower alternative.
slots.dest: The Old Mill Pottery House Café, 3341 Old Mill St, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.why: Twenty minutes on the Spur. Long nap. Tonight is late-ish.

Free parking, free to walk in. The Flying Horse carousel, the Great Smoky Mountain Wheel ($18.99, $13.99 for Cash, ask about Snejana), Santa photos by the wheel, a mile of Winterfest lights. Ben and Jerry's. It is the easiest three hours in Pigeon Forge with three kids.
slots.dest: The Island in Pigeon Forge, 131 The Island Dr, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.why: Timberwood Grill or whatever has no line. Eat at 5:30; by 6:30 everything has a wait.
The Winterfest fountain show runs at 6, 7, 8 and 9 in the courtyard with the three LED trees. Watch the 6 o'clock from a bench, then the Spur home. Bed by 7:30.

callouts.body: Iron Mountain's rules: the railroad spike knife is 13 and up, the horseshoe is 9 and up, the pony shoe is a smaller knife at $35, and the nail knife is 5 to 12 at $20. Cash qualifies for the nail knife only; don't argue it up a tier, the smith won't. Slavik and Snejana watch from behind the rope or walk the square with Allison. Sessions take 15 minutes of your hammering plus the smith's finishing; plan an hour for both of you. Reviewers' consensus is that this is the thing their kids talked about all the way home.

2026-11-24.title: Easy morning, Anakeesta at dusk
2026-11-24.note: Nobody drives far today. Short walk in the park, long nap, then the mountaintop for the lights.

slots.why: Two miles south of town on US-441. Buy the $15 weekly parking tag here and put it on the dash. Free museum inside with the stuffed animals, which buys you twenty minutes if it's cold.
The trail starts behind the visitor center. Under half a mile, flat, dirt. The shortest walk to a waterfall in the park. Cash walks, Slavik walks most of it, Snejana rides in the carrier.
Half a mile, fully paved, flat. The one trail in the park where the stroller actually works. Creek, old chimney, done by eleven.
slots.addr: Newfound Gap Rd, 0.3 mi south of the visitor center

slots.why: Protect this. Tonight runs late.

Base is at 576 Parkway. Use the McMahan garage at traffic light #3 or the garage across from the aquarium. The gondola cabins fit a stroller, so bring it up. Adults $34.99, Cash $22.99, the little two free. Buy online.
slots.addr: Anakeesta base: 576 Parkway. Garage: McMahan, traffic light #3

slots.what: Treehouse play area and Vista Gardens in daylight
slots.why: The Treehouse Adventure play structure is the toddler payoff. Treetop Skywalk is included but no strollers and no carrying, so one adult does it with Cash while the other stays at the playground.
Enchanted Christmas is the whole mountaintop lit up. Half an hour of walking it is plenty. Cliff Top has food if you'd rather eat up there than fight downtown.
The Chondola line down gets long after 6:30. Be in it by 6:15.

2026-11-25.title: Cades Cove
2026-11-25.note: The 11-mile loop through the valley with the deer, turkeys, old churches and sometimes a bear. An hour-plus each way from the cabin on Little River Road, so you leave early and you are back for naps.

slots.what: Roll out, breakfast in the car
slots.why: Little River Road from Sugarlands. Wildlife is out at this hour and the loop is empty. Leave at nine and you crawl behind forty cars.
slots.addr: Cades Cove Loop Rd via Little River Rd and Laurel Creek Rd

slots.why: One way, 20 mph, pull-offs everywhere. Get out at John Oliver Cabin, half a mile flat from the road. Cash counts deer.
Visitor center, restrooms, a working grist mill and barns on flat gravel. Stroller works here. Thirty minutes of running around, then back in the car.
slots.addr: Cades Cove Visitor Center, Cable Mill

slots.why: Lunch in the car or at the Metcalf Bottoms picnic area on the way back if it's warm enough.
slots.addr: Metcalf Bottoms picnic area, Little River Rd

slots.why: Long nap. Everyone, including adults.
Food City on East Parkway for tomorrow's dinner. Wednesday afternoon is the last sane time to do it. Food City runs holiday hours Thursday.
Great Smoky Thanksgiving Arts & Crafts Show at the Gatlinburg Convention Center, Nov 24 to 29. Free, indoor, warm, and an easy hour if the kids are restless. Skip it if they aren't.

callouts.h: Bears are real in the Cove in November
callouts.body: They are fattening up before denning and they are on the loop. Fifty yards minimum, nobody gets out of the car for a bear, and no food left out at the picnic area. If a bear jam forms, drive through it. You will see another one.

2026-11-26.title: Thanksgiving
2026-11-26.note: Dollywood is closed and most of the town is at a buffet. Ober in the morning for the bears and the tubing hill, the big meal at the cabin at four, and the chairlift lights if everyone is still standing.

slots.why: Tram base at 1001 Parkway. $29 round trip for ages 5 and up, Slavik and Snejana ride free. Strollers fold and come aboard. Opening hours vary by day in early season, so check the night before.
Black bears, otters and raccoons behind glass. The one thing up here all three can do, and the bears are most active in the morning.

slots.what: Snow tubing: Cash, Slavik and one adult
slots.why: The tubing park opened for the season Nov 20 and runs all weather. Day tickets are good 11 to 5 with unlimited runs: a 350-foot hill, a 50-foot drop, and a moving carpet back up. At seven Cash rides alone and has to be 42 inches, so measure him first. Slavik rides on a ticketed adult's lap; Ober lists the little-kid ticket as ages 3 and 4 for about $3, so he's a big three-year-old at the window. Snejana stays with the other adults at the bears and the rink. Tubing tickets do not include the tram. Thanksgiving is a holiday price, about $50 for Cash and the adult, and it sells out: buy online tonight. Secured shoes and waterproof gloves for both boys, no food or drink on the hill.

slots.what: Tennessee Flyer mountain coaster, both boys
slots.why: Loads beside the tubing hill. Ages 3 and up, passenger seat 38 inches, so Cash and Slavik each ride in front of an adult who works the brake levers. Two per cart, 300 lb limit, 3,750 feet of track, 25 mph if you let it. $18 a ride, or buy the Adventure Pass for unlimited coaster plus the tram, bears and skating. Closes in ice. Skating only if there's still time and the Fun Pass covers it.
Snack lunch on the way. Everyone down by 2.
A turkey breast, not a turkey. Cabin ovens are small and unreliable. Sides from Food City Wednesday. If you'd rather not cook, the backup is below, and it needs booking before you leave Birmingham.

slots.what: Lights Over Gatlinburg from the SkyLift
slots.why: 765 Parkway, 15 minutes from the table. Included with SkyPark admission, runs nightly. Each chair holds three heartbeats and the baby counts, so you're two chairs. No strollers anywhere in the park. Snejana rides in the carrier on a lap. Skip this if dinner ran long. It's a bonus, not a plan.

callouts.h: If you want someone else to cook
callouts.body: Mama's Farmhouse, 208 Pickel St, Pigeon Forge Directions. Family-style, all you can eat, a special Thanksgiving menu, open 11 to 9. The right call for this crew because food arrives in bowls immediately and nobody needs a menu. Reservations are encouraged and it fills up. Book it today as the backup even if you plan to cook. Ober Mountain runs a Thanksgiving Feast at the top, 11 to 5, which would fold the whole morning into one trip; reservations there too. Cracker Barrel on the Pigeon Forge Parkway serves its traditional plate from 11 with no reservation, and The Park Grill in Gatlinburg has a special menu 11:30 to 9. The Pigeon Forge trolley doesn't run on Thanksgiving, so whatever you pick, you're driving.

2026-11-27.title: Up the mountain, away from everyone
2026-11-27.note: The Parkway, the Island, Dollywood and the outlets will be the busiest they are all year. Do not go near any of it. Kuwohi Road closes Monday for the winter. This is the last chance.

slots.what: Newfound Gap Road south from Sugarlands
slots.why: Thirteen miles climbing to Newfound Gap at 5,046 feet, then seven miles of Kuwohi Road. Dress everyone for 35 degrees and wind regardless of what the cabin thermometer says. If the road is gated for ice, turn around; there's no second route.
Half a mile paved and steep to the tower. Not a stroller walk. Snejana in the carrier, Slavik on shoulders for the second half. The highest point in Tennessee, and Cash can say he walked to it.
slots.addr: End of Kuwohi Rd, 7 mi off Newfound Gap

slots.what: Newfound Gap on the way down
slots.why: Stand on the state line. Restrooms here. Chimneys picnic area lower down if it's warm enough to sit outside.
Pull the muddy gear onto the porch, run laundry, box what won't get used again. Saturday morning gets ugly otherwise.

At Soaky Mountain Waterpark, $39.95 per car Friday, opens at 6, rain or shine. Kids stay in their car seats in pajamas with the radio synced to the lights. Forty minutes, then they're asleep before you're back. Sevierville traffic on Black Friday is the price. Leave early or skip it.
slots.addr: Soaky Mountain Waterpark, 175 Soaky Way, Sevierville

callouts.h: If the high road is closed
callouts.body: Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail is the fallback, and it also closes Monday. Turn at traffic light #8 onto Historic Nature Trail, five and a half miles one way, narrow and slow, past the Noah Ogle place and a few cabins. Ogle's is a hundred yards from the road and fine for all three. Grotto Falls is not a toddler walk. Then the Gatlinburg Trail from Sugarlands, two miles each way on gravel, flat, stroller-fine, with the river the whole way.

slots.why: Check under every bed, the hot tub deck, and the loft. Loveys get left in cabins the same way they get left at beach houses. Bears do not take them. Probably.
Little River Road to Townsend, US-321 to Lenoir City, I-75 south. Saturday after Thanksgiving is the second heaviest checkout day of the year on the Spur and TN-66. The park route misses all of it.
slots.addr: Little River Rd to Townsend Wye, then US-321

slots.what: Chattanooga, back on I-59. You just got an hour back

bonus.title: Dollywood
bonus.note: Not on the calendar on purpose. If a day dawns clear, everyone slept, and you want it, swap it in for Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday from the hub. It is closed Thursday and mobbed Friday and Saturday. Park opens at 10, be in the lot at 9:15. Parking $25. $94.99 adults, $84.99 for Cash through Nov 25, the little two free. Buy online the night before.

slots.what: Park, tram to the gate, measure Cash
slots.why: The measuring station on Showstreet gives him a wristband for the day. 42 inches opens Blazing Fury and Sky Rider. 48 opens the real coasters. Don't guess, measure.

Back of the park, so go first while everyone else stops at the front. Frogs and Fireflies, Treetop Tower, the Great Tree Swing at 36 inches, and the splash-free Wildwood Creek playground. This is Slavik's whole park.
The steam train. No height minimum, twenty minutes sitting down, and the single best thing for Snejana. Ride it before lunch while she's still happy.

Carousel and Lemon Twist have no minimum. Santa is in the Imagination Playhouse near the train depot. Cash and one adult peel off for Blazing Fury and whatever his wristband allows. Use Parent Swap so nobody waits twice.
Snejana and probably Slavik go down in the stroller. Walk slow through Craftsman's Valley. One adult takes Cash to the Country Fair rides, which are 36 inches and up.

slots.what: Dinner in the park, then the lights come on
slots.why: Snow in the Grove runs in Wildwood Grove each evening with the characters. Glacier Ridge and Peppermint Valley are the light walks. Get through the Grove first, then Glacier Ridge on the way out.
The 9pm close is for people without a one-year-old. Out by seven, home by 7:45, bed. Tomorrow is a recovery day on purpose.

callouts.body: No minimum: Dollywood Express, Village Carousel, Lemon Twist, Flying Elephants, Rockin' Roadway. Treetop Tower and Frogs and Fireflies need a 14+ companion under 42 and 36 inches. The Country Fair kiddie rides moved to a 36-inch minimum for 2026, so Slavik may be shut out of Busy Bees and Lucky Ducky. At 42 inches Cash gets Blazing Fury, Sky Rider and the Waltzing Swinger. At 48 inches he gets Thunderhead, Mystery Mine and Barnstormer. A seven-year-old is usually right around 48, so measure him at the cabin Sunday night and again at the park.
